manifest.declaration: These post hoc controls were introduced after inspecting the first three held-out test cases, where random_checked spent all fuel. They test proposal support and fixed-library search. No model weights or parameters were tuned, and the original benchmark results are preserved.
manifest.timing_note: Observed wall time on a shared computer, not an isolated latency benchmark.

limitations: These post hoc controls were introduced after inspecting the first three held-out test cases, where random_checked spent all fuel. They test proposal support and fixed-library search. No model weights or parameters were tuned, and the original benchmark results are preserved.
Small fixed mission samples; supplemental comparisons are exploratory.
Fixed checked scores 29 proposals; random with coast scores 16.
Interventions count selection away from the first coast proposal, not repair of a learned action.
Fuel averages include failures; compare fuel and success together.
Candidate ranking is numerical look-ahead, not a rigorous safety shield.
